profile.headline: Software Engineer & Designer

positions.title: Software Engineer & Designer
positions.description:
United Airlines / SuperFriendly / Big Medium: Built 30+ production React components to WCAG 2.1 AA for united.com's design system, alongside Dan Mall and Brad Frost. Storybook docs, 6 responsive product templates, full test coverage with Jest

Studio for Extensive Aesthetics (Emily Carr): AI and machine learning work using Python, StyleGAN2, and GPT-2 for image production

Participedia: Lead developer and co-designer for an open-source platform. Advised the director on technical strategy and built the frontend (Node.js, Express, Postgres)

San Francisco Space Program: Responsive web design and development for an artist residency (React, Next.js, Strapi)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Kinside partners with daycares and preschools nationwide, connecting working parents with available and reliable child care that works for their lives and their budgets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Adventurous Co is a storytelling platform that takes families on mixed reality adventures through their local neighborhoods.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- building/debugging complex UIs and full stack features across the website and Superset–Airbnb’s opensource BI app
- collaborating with designers, data scientists, PMs and other engineers to brainstorm/develop new features
- mentoring interns and new grads
- spoke on a panel at OpenAir 2015 called “How Tech Can Reach Underserved Communities”
- maintaining/improving code quality, processes and culture in hyper-growth mode -- team has grown from 19 to 600+ engineers
- interviewing candidates across departments for culture fit, using our core values as a guide
- lead a team to develop a system to support hosts who want to open their homes for free to those displaced by natural disaster
